**TMUCRD public-background profile — source snapshot.** Publicly available peer-reviewed material describes the Taipei Medical University Clinical Research Database (TMUCRD) as a real-world-data repository derived from EHRs and other sources from Taipei Medical University Hospital, Wan-Fang Hospital, and Shuang-Ho Hospital. The paper reports standardized conversion to the OMOP Common Data Model and, for its reported snapshot, 89 tables, >4.15 million patients, and records spanning 2004–2021, covering domains such as demographics, diagnoses, medications, procedures, and measurements; it also reports linkage to mortality and cancer-registry data. Source snapshot: Nguyen PA et al., published 14 May 2024; reported data period 2004–2021; accessed 27 July 2026. DOI: [10.1136/bmjhci-2023-100890](https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjhci-2023-100890). TMU institutional record: [publication page](https://hub.tmu.edu.tw/en/publications/taipei-medical-university-clinical-research-database-a-collaborat/).

**Boundary.** This is a public, publication-level description only—not a schema, data dictionary, data-access statement, or institutional query guide. It does not establish the present release, field names/types, table availability, code systems, keys, joins, time semantics, hospital-specific coverage, or permissions. No private metadata has been inferred; any analysis must be based on the current owner-approved documentation and live extract metadata.

Evidence class: peer-reviewed publication (descriptive, not governing). Search snapshot: web searches for exact TMUCRD name/DOI on 2026-07-27.
